parsed.post: Massive improvement! Dropping from 1.0429 to 0.8926 by switching to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10'. It seems the extra shard provides significant data benefits within the 5-minute budget. Next: I'll attempt to increase capacity by moving to DEPTH=6 to see if the model can further leverage this more data.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 while keeping the all-shard fix (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10') to increase model capacity.
